item.title: Soldier Salute Heavyweight Title Goes to Hopke
item.description: MINNEAPOLIS – Minnesota redshirt freshman Koy Hopke won the heavyweight title as action concluded Sunday at the Soldier Salute in Coralville, Iowa. item.title: College Recruiting: state placewinner Luebke to Concordia College
item.description: Jacob Luebke of Dilworth-Glyndon-Felton has committed to wrestling for Concordia College next season. Luebke is a four-time state qualifier for The Rebels, placing sixth at 126 pounds in Class A in 2023 as a freshman. Luebke is projected to wrestle at 141 or 149 pounds for the Cobbers.
